column1: # RT-core (TTU) BVH byte format — cross-validated field map + concrete test vectors.
# Recovered from analysis of the RT runtime/test binaries + the BVH builder + nvdisasm SASS.
# Three independent producers agree on every layout: the hardware diag RT-core test
# (explicit byte construction + known geometry oracle), the OptiX wide-BVH builder
# (bit-field spec headers w/ sizeof asserts), and the DXR->rtcore acceleration-structure
# builder. Byte layouts + test vectors are bare interface facts. Confidence HIGH unless noted.
# Bit offsets are within the named struct (LE bit packing); byte = bit/8. Word layout = u32 reg[].
# Columns: struct  byte_off  bit_off  size_bits  field  type  meaning  source_agreement  confidence
# ============ COMPLET (compressed BVH node) — 128 bytes, 128B aligned, 32B header + 11/12x 8B child ============

column7: long-ptr mode: last child slot holds 17b high ptr bits instead of a box
leaf pointer is relative(offset) vs absolute
X scale exponent: dx=bitcast(xscl<<23); placed in FP32 exponent field
box origin/anchor X (FP31 w/ 3b shearExpOffset in LSBs when leafType=3)
low bits of leaf/item base ptr (128B-aligned: bits[6:0]=0)
high bits of leaf/item base ptr (15b item, 17b leaf)
misc[27:24]: first triangle index in leaf range
misc[31:28]: this complet's index within parent (0xF=root)
parent ptr: lptr=0 signed rel ofs (bits[38:7], <<7); lptr=1 abs low 32b
first-child ptr: lptr=0 signed rel ofs (<<7=128B); lptr=1 abs low 32b
(longPtr u64@120 bits[16:0]) high bits of abs parent ptr
(longPtr u64@120 bits[48:32]) high bits of abs child ptr

column1: # ---- complet child record (8 bytes), 11 records @ byte 32..119 (slot 11 reused as longPtr hi when lptr=1) ----

column7: quantized child AABB lower X (256 buckets/axis)
leaf-descriptor byte (union by leafType; see notes)
TriRange leaf: number of cache lines touched (bits[2:0])
TriRange leaf: triangle index in first line (bits[6:3])
bit6: this child is a leaf

column1: # empty child sentinel: xlo=0xFF xhi=0x00 ylo=0xFF yhi=0x00 zlo=0xFF zhi=0x00 (lo>hi => degenerate box)

column7: scl = exp(xmax-xmin) ; +1 if mantissa!=0 (round up so dx>=len, box always encloses)

column1: # ============ TEST VECTOR A: root-AABB scale exponent (concrete) ============

column7: len=2.0 -> bitcast=0x40000000 exp=128 mantissa=0 -> scl=0x80(128) dx=2.0 exact

column1: # ============ TEST VECTOR B: child quantization (+X half of root) ============

column7: child = +X half of root: X=[0, +4/3] (origin xmin=-4/3, dx=4.0)

column1: # ============ TEST VECTOR C: hit record (Triangle hit, 16B = 4x u32) ============

column7: synth hit: triId=7 t=2.5 u=0.25 v=0.5 alpha=0 facing=1
d3>>31=0 -> Triangle; triId=d0; t=bitcast(d1&0x7FFFFFFF); u=bitcast(d2&..); v=bitcast(d3&..); alpha=d1>>31; facing=d2>>31
trirange hit: d3 nibble 0b1001 bit27=0 => TriRange

column1: # ============ RAY REQUEST (3x 16-byte regs in TTU internal addr space) ============

column7: [reg1 hi u32]: motion-blur timestamp (GA10x+, else ignored)

column1: # ============ TTU INTERNAL ADDRESS-SPACE SLOT MAP (ttuAddr[U16] indices) — from kernel TTUST/TTULD ============
# compressed (mode 1): vertex deltas; uncompressed (mode 0): full FP32 verts, 3 tris/line

column7: first-vertex anchor X (compressed) / v0.x of tri0 (uncompressed)
bit-packed vertex-pos deltas / vertex-IDs(4b ea) / alpha+fnc / tri-ID deltas
base triangle ID; per-tri IDs are PID-bit deltas
LSBs discarded in compression; deltas re-shifted on decode

column1: # uncompressed (mode 0): triData[31] bits[21:20]=numTris-1, bits[19:17]=fnc(3 tris); triData[30-i]=triId; verts[i*3+{0,1,2}]

column7: tri0: v0@byte0 v1@byte12 v2@byte24 (9xf32); triId@word30(byte120); fnc=bit17 word31
user instance ID low + packed SBT offset/flags (DXR mapping)
pointer to child BLAS root complet
3x4 affine, 12x FP32 ROW-MAJOR m[row*4+col]; stores world->object inverse

column1: # ============ AS BUFFER HEADER (BvhHeader) — precedes first complet, 128B-aligned ============

column7: offsets+counts table: nodesOffset(complets,16B-aligned) trianglesOffset indicesOffset instanceNodeOffset remapOffset apmOffset; counts numNodes numTriangles numTriBlocks maxInstances; motion timeBegin/End numKeys; compatibilityId baseVA buildFlags; compaction sub-struct; splitCostCoeff[6]

column7: displacement scale (kept small to avoid misses)
Standard format SM_86+ (10 on Turing/<SM_86); MotionBlur=5(SM_86+)
spec max child slots; slot 11 reused for longPtr hi bits when lptr=1
xlo xhi ylo yhi zlo zhi rval data
